to.implementation_strategy: Extend the existing take-up/context-review language gate (core/context_review or core/iteration_planner edit-growth policy) to read optional item.planned_change (per-path added/removed/new_defs/new_branches, approximate OK) from /api/v1/backlog/items/{item_id} and apply the SAME edit-growth thresholds so Gate 1 returns a combined Go/Python verdict for file kind + planned size. Reuse code_quality_gate thresholds from config/ci-cd-gates.json; no new component.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES item schema to accept optional planned_change field (backlog item model + groom API)
RELATED BI-PF-0339: architecture descriptor is a natural source of approximate planned_change
conflict_findings: Possible overlap with BI-PF-0343 (ENG-4 worker runtime) if it also consumes language gate; keep verdict logic in core gate module
duplication_findings: No existing item exposes planned_change consumption; BI-PF-0339 (ENG-0 architecture descriptor) is upstream producer, not duplicate
Edit-growth policy already exists in iteration_planner/code_quality_gate - reuse, do not reimplement
to.rationale: Small extension of an existing gate with reused thresholds; makes Gate 1 verdict deterministic in one pass and avoids rework. Optional field keeps it backward compatible.
assumptions: item.planned_change is optional and may be absent -> fall back to existing file-kind-only verdict
Edit-growth thresholds are shared config, not per-gate constants
risks: planned_change values are approximate; wrong thresholds could emit false Python verdicts early
Gate 1 timing: verdict must not slow item fetch
evidence: Candidate reuse list includes iteration_planner.py, code_quality_gate.py, ci-cd-gates.json
missing_info: Authoritative threshold for 'large edit -> Go' (added+removed lines cutoff)
Verdict precedence when file kind and planned size disagree
